items.question: Do you guarantee the first position on Google?
items.answer: No, and be wary of anyone who does: nobody controls Google's rankings. The first position is the goal we work towards every month, and a plain English report shows you what was done and how your visibility is moving.

items.question: What exactly does the plan include?
items.answer: All four pillars for {price} a month {tax}: authority content, backlinks and citations, authority on Google and AI, and review management. Nothing is billed separately.

items.question: How long before I see results in local search rankings?
items.answer: Most clients see meaningful movement in the local map pack within 30 to 60 days, though competitive markets can take longer.

items.question: Why is part of it paid up front?
items.answer: On signing, {upfront}% is paid up front. It covers the tools and services we take on to do the work from day one.

items.question: Do I need a website or a Google profile already?
items.answer: No. If you don't have a Google Business Profile we set it up and verify it in your name, and a website can be added as an optional service at {discount}% off.

items.question: How does the discount on optional services work?
items.answer: Website Development, AI Voice Receptionist and Software Development are {discount}% off their list price when taken alongside Local SEO. Bought on their own, they cost the list price.

business.title: About Lorenzoz Agency
paragraphs: Lorenzoz Agency builds solutions for local businesses of any size, and what we sell is one outcome: new customers. Everything rests on a single core offer, Local SEO, which works on four fronts at once: authority content, backlinks and citations, authority on Google and in AI answers, and review management.

Around that core sit three optional services, each available on its own or alongside Local SEO: Website Development, an AI Voice Receptionist and Software Development. We are registered in Xinzo de Limia (Ourense, Spain) and work online with clients worldwide, with a focus on Australia, Canada, Costa Rica, Ireland, New Zealand, Spain, the United Kingdom and the United States. The division of labour is simple: the client focuses on delivering their own service well, and we take care of winning their customers and following them up.

items.question: Do you guarantee the first position on Google?
items.answer: No, and be wary of anyone who does: nobody controls Google's rankings. The first position is the goal we work towards every month, and a plain English report shows you what was done and how your visibility is moving.

items.question: How long before I see results in local search rankings?
items.answer: Most clients see meaningful movement in the local map pack within 30 to 60 days, though competitive markets can take longer.

items.question: Do I need a Google Business Profile already?
items.answer: No. If you don't have one yet, we set it up and verify it for you as part of onboarding.

items.question: Does this cover more than one location?
items.answer: Yes. Businesses with several locations are supported, and each location gets its own optimised profile and local content.

items.question: Which review platforms do you monitor?
items.answer: Google Business Profile is the main channel, alongside Facebook and any site specific to your sector that matters for your business. We can add more sources as your needs grow.

items.question: How do you get more reviews?
items.answer: With branded feedback links that make it easy for your customers to leave a review. They go to every customer, not just the happy ones: filtering who gets asked is against Google's policies.
